# iHaveTools

> Free online tools for everyday work — calculators, text utilities, image tools, converters and developer helpers. Everything runs in your browser. 98 tools, free, no sign-up. Every tool runs locally in the visitor's browser; user files and text are never uploaded.

## Categories
- [PDF & Documents tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/pdf/): Merge, split and work with PDF files directly in your browser. Files never leave your device.
- [Image tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/image/): Compress, resize, convert and crop images locally. No uploads, no quality surprises, no waiting.
- [Video tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/video/): Inspect video files and pull out their audio track — processed locally in your browser.
- [Audio tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/audio/): Generate, trim and re-speed audio without uploading a thing. Decoded and rendered in your browser.
- [Text tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/text/): Counters, case converters, sorters and diff tools for working with text quickly.
- [Calculators tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/calculators/): Everyday calculators for percentages, loans, discounts, health and money decisions.
- [Converters tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/converters/): Convert between units of length, weight, temperature, data and more with exact factors.
- [Developer tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/developer/): Formatters, encoders, decoders and generators for daily development work.
- [Security tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/security/): Password, hash and randomness tools built on your browser’s cryptographic APIs.
- [Web & SEO tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/web-seo/): Meta tags, robots.txt, sitemaps and URL utilities for site owners and marketers.
- [Color tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/color/): Pick, convert and compare colors — HEX, RGB, HSL, contrast ratios and palettes.
- [Data tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/data/): Convert between CSV, JSON and JSON Lines with correct quoting and escaping.
- [Math tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/math/): Averages, ratios, GCD/LCM and other small math utilities with clear results.
- [Date & Time tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/datetime/): Date differences, date arithmetic and time zone conversion without the mental math.
- [Student tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/student/): Scientific, fraction and duration calculators for homework and study.
- [Miscellaneous tools](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/categories/misc/): Useful tools that do not fit a neat box — starting with cryptographically random numbers.

## Tools
- [JSON Formatter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/json-formatter/): Format, validate and minify JSON with precise error messages.
- [JSON Validator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/json-validator/): Check JSON syntax and get the exact line and column of errors.
- [JSON Minifier](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/json-minifier/): Strip whitespace from JSON and see how many bytes you saved.
- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/base64-encoder/): Unicode-safe Base64 encoding and decoding, with URL-safe output.
- [URL Encoder & Decoder](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/url-encoder/): Percent-encode or decode text and whole URLs, correctly.
- [UUID Generator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/uuid-generator/): Bulk-generate RFC 4122 v4 UUIDs with cryptographic randomness.
- [Timestamp Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/timestamp-converter/): Convert Unix timestamps to dates and back, in UTC and local time.
- [Hash Generator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/hash-generator/): SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 hashes via Web Crypto.
- [Regex Tester](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/regex-tester/): Test regular expressions live with match highlighting and groups.
- [JWT Decoder](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/jwt-decoder/): Decode JWT headers and payloads and inspect expiry times.
- [HTML Formatter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/html-formatter/): Indent messy HTML into clean, readable markup.
- [CSS Formatter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/css-formatter/): Beautify or minify CSS with a real tokenizer.
- [JavaScript Formatter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/js-formatter/): Re-indent JavaScript with a string- and template-aware tokenizer.
- [Extract Audio from Video](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/extract-audio/): Pull the sound out of any video and save it as a WAV file.
- [MP4 Inspector](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/mp4-inspector/): Read duration, resolution, codecs and bitrate straight from MP4 bytes.
- [Tone Generator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/tone-generator/): Play or download pure tones — sine, square, sawtooth, triangle.
- [Audio Trimmer](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/audio-trimmer/): Cut audio files precisely and export the selection as WAV.
- [Audio Speed Changer](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/audio-speed-changer/): Speed audio up to 4× or slow it to 0.25×, with volume boost.
- [Word Counter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/word-counter/): Live word, character, sentence and reading-time counts.
- [Character Counter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/character-counter/): Count characters and check limits for tweets, SMS and meta tags.
- [Line Counter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/line-counter/): Count total, empty and non-empty lines, and the longest line.
- [Case Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/case-converter/): UPPER, lower, Title, Sentence, camelCase, snake_case and more.
- [Remove Duplicate Lines](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/remove-duplicate-lines/): Delete repeated lines — case-sensitive or not — keeping order.
- [Text Sorter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/text-sorter/): Sort lines A–Z, numerically, by length or naturally.
- [Text Diff](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/text-diff/): Compare two texts line by line and see what changed.
- [Slug Generator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/slug-generator/): Turn any title into a clean, SEO-friendly URL slug.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/lorem-ipsum-generator/): Generate placeholder paragraphs, sentences or words on demand.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/percentage-calculator/): Three percentage calculations in one tool, with worked formulas.
- [Percentage Change](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/percentage-change/): Percentage increase or decrease between two values.
- [Discount Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/discount-calculator/): Sale price and savings from a price and percent off.
- [Age Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/age-calculator/): Exact age in years, months and days — plus the next birthday.
- [BMI Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/bmi-calculator/): Body Mass Index in metric or imperial, with WHO categories.
- [GST Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/gst-calculator/): Add or remove GST at any rate, with CGST/SGST split.
- [EMI Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/emi-calculator/): Monthly EMI, total interest and repayment for any loan.
- [Tip Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/tip-calculator/): Tip amount, total and fair per-person split in seconds.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/compound-interest-calculator/): Growth of savings with compounding, contributions and a schedule.
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/simple-interest-calculator/): Straightforward interest: principal × rate × time.
- [Length Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/length-converter/): Metres, feet, inches, miles, km, cm and more.
- [Weight Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/weight-converter/): Kilograms, pounds, ounces, stone, tonnes and more.
- [Temperature Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/temperature-converter/): Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin and Rankine.
- [Time Unit Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/time-converter/): Seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months and years.
- [Speed Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/speed-converter/): km/h, mph, m/s, knots and more.
- [Data Storage Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/data-storage-converter/): Bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB — decimal and binary (KiB, MiB, GiB).
- [Area Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/area-converter/): Square metres, feet, acres, hectares and more.
- [Volume Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/volume-converter/): Litres, millilitres, gallons, cups, tablespoons and more.
- [Password Generator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/password-generator/): Strong random passwords with entropy readout — all local.
- [Password Strength Checker](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/password-strength-checker/): Entropy, crack-time estimates and weakness checks — locally.
- [Random String Generator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/random-string-generator/): Bulk random strings and keys from your browser’s CSPRNG.
- [Image Compressor](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/image-compressor/): Shrink JPG, PNG and WebP in your browser — no uploads.
- [Image Resizer](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/image-resizer/): Resize images to exact pixels, keeping the aspect ratio.
- [Image Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/image-converter/): Convert between PNG, JPG and WebP — transparent → white.
- [Image Cropper](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/image-cropper/): Crop images with drag selection and aspect presets.
- [Image Metadata Viewer](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/image-metadata-viewer/): Inspect EXIF data and PNG chunks — fully offline.
- [Color Picker](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/color-picker/): Pick colors, get every format, plus tints and shades.
- [HEX / RGB / HSL Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/hex-rgb-converter/): Convert colors between HEX, RGB and HSL — both ways.
- [Color Contrast Checker](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/color-contrast-checker/): WCAG AA/AAA contrast ratios with pass/fail verdicts.
- [Palette Generator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/palette-generator/): Build color harmonies from one base color.
- [Meta Tag Generator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/meta-tag-generator/): Generate SEO, Open Graph and Twitter meta tags in one go.
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/robots-txt-generator/): Build a valid robots.txt with rules, presets and sitemap.
- [Sitemap Generator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/sitemap-generator/): Paste URLs, get a valid sitemap.xml to download.
- [Open Graph Preview](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/open-graph-preview/): Preview how a link looks when shared on social platforms.
- [URL Parser](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/url-parser/): Break any URL into protocol, host, path and query params.
- [Keyword Density Checker](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/keyword-density-checker/): Top words and phrases with density percentages.
- [Scientific Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/scientific-calculator/): Full expression calculator with functions, history and keyboard support.
- [Fraction Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/fraction-calculator/): Add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions — simplified.
- [Time Duration Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/time-duration-calculator/): Add or subtract durations like 2h 45m + 30m.
- [Average Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/average-calculator/): Mean, median, mode, range and more from a list of numbers.
- [Ratio Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/ratio-calculator/): Simplify ratios and solve for the missing value.
- [GCD & LCM Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/gcd-lcm-calculator/): Greatest common divisor and least common multiple, with steps.
- [Date Difference](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/date-difference/): Days, weeks, months and weekdays between two dates.
- [Date Add / Subtract](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/date-add-calculator/): Add or subtract days, weeks, months or years from a date.
- [Time Zone Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/time-zone-converter/): Convert a time between any two IANA time zones.
- [CSV to JSON](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/csv-to-json/): RFC 4180-correct CSV conversion, with header row support.
- [JSON to CSV](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/json-to-csv/): JSON arrays to properly escaped CSV, with column selection.
- [JSON Lines Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/json-lines-converter/): Convert JSON ⇄ JSON Lines (NDJSON) with per-line validation.
- [Random Number Generator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/random-number-generator/): Truly random numbers in any range — lottery-grade fairness.
- [Dice Roller](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/dice-roller/): Roll up to 12 dice with any number of sides — crypto-random.
- [PDF Merge](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/pdf-merge/): Combine PDFs in order — processed entirely in your browser.
- [PDF Rotate](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/pdf-rotate/): Rotate every page or just some pages by 90°, 180° or 270°.
- [PDF Split](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/pdf-split/): Extract page ranges or split a PDF into separate files.
- [SIP Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/sip-calculator/): Estimate mutual fund SIP returns with a year-by-year growth table.
- [PPF Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/ppf-calculator/): PPF maturity, interest and year-by-year balance at the current 7.1% rate.
- [FD Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/fd-calculator/): Fixed deposit maturity and interest with quarterly compounding.
- [Image to PDF](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/image-to-pdf/): Turn JPG, PNG or WebP images into one PDF — in your browser.
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/income-tax-calculator/): India income tax for FY 2025-26 — old vs new regime compared instantly.
- [JPG to PNG Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/jpg-to-png/): Convert JPG/JPEG images to PNG losslessly, right in your browser.
- [PNG to JPG Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/png-to-jpg/): Convert PNG images to smaller JPGs, with a background colour for transparency.
- [WebP to PNG Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/webp-to-png/): Convert WebP images to widely-compatible PNGs, locally and free.
- [JPG to WebP Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/jpg-to-webp/): Convert JPG photos to modern, smaller WebP files for the web.
- [YouTube Thumbnail Downloader](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/youtube-thumbnail-downloader/): Download any YouTube video thumbnail in HD, SD and more sizes.
- [QR Code Generator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/qr-code-generator/): Create QR codes for links, text and Wi-Fi — download as PNG or SVG.
- [RD Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/rd-calculator/): Recurring deposit maturity with quarterly compounding and a yearly table.
- [CAGR Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/cagr-calculator/): Compound annual growth rate from start value, end value and years.
- [Gratuity Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/gratuity-calculator/): Estimate gratuity with the statutory (15/26) × salary × years formula.
- [Number Base Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/number-base-converter/): Convert between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal — exactly, at any size.
- [Roman Numeral Converter](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/roman-numeral-converter/): Convert numbers to Roman numerals and back, with strict standard rules.
- [Morse Code Translator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/morse-code-translator/): Translate text to Morse code and back — with sound playback.
- [Lumpsum Calculator](https://i-have-tools.vercel.app/tools/lumpsum-calculator/): Future value of a one-time investment, with year-by-year growth.
